housing: Runnymede is a Surrey commuter borough along the Thames, with high house prices and some of Surrey's highest private renting, helped by Royal Holloway, University of London in Egham. Egham and Englefield Green have many student shared houses, while Addlestone and Chertsey mix Victorian terraces, post-war estates and new apartment blocks. Virginia Water is known for very large detached houses, and low-lying parts of Egham Hythe, Thorpe and Chertsey near the Thames are prone to flooding.
checkinTips: Student houses in Egham and Englefield Green: photograph each bedroom lock, fire doors, alarms and the shared kitchen and bathroom separately.
Homes near the Thames in Egham Hythe, Thorpe and Chertsey: photograph any tide marks, damp low on walls, air bricks and flood barriers.
Large houses in Virginia Water and Ottershaw: record gates, alarms, garden equipment and any pool or outbuildings included in the let.
New apartments in Addlestone town centre: note fob and key counts, parking bays, bike stores and balconies.
Homes under the Heathrow flight paths: note window and door seals and any trickle vents.
tenantHelp: Tenants can report disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions in privately rented homes to Runnymede Borough Council's environmental health team.
